title: Hollister Is Prepping for an Olivia Rodrigo Summer With a Restock of These Bestselling Baby Tees
summary: The shirts are in high demand since she announced her You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

In honor of Olivia Rodrigo’s upcoming new album, You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love , Hollister has restocked its bestselling baby tees from the singer’s Sour era.

At press time, 100+ people were viewing these two tees, hoping to add them to their carts, and it’s easy to see why. The pieces retail for $24.95 each and feature a flattering slim fit. The first time both shirts were introduced on the site, they sold like hotcakes in almost all sizes. The full restock for both baby tees is available now from XXS to XXL, a ton of sizing for everybody. It is likely that these baby tees won’t be in stock for long, given how stylish they are, coupled with Rodrigo’s popularity. Both tees are officially licensed merchandise.

The Olivia Rodrigo Graphic Baby Tee is gray with Sour -esque graphics (her debut album), from Polaroid pics to records in purple on both the front and back. The tee is made of 100% cotton for a breathable finish, and can be machine washed. The style is modeled after a classic ringer tee with a scoop neck and short sleeves that stop high up on the biceps. The hem is cropped slightly, baring a smidge of the midriff.

Olivia Rodrigo Graphic Baby Tee

$24.95

Buy Now at hollister

This is a slim-fit baby tee with graphics from Olivia Rodrigo’s Sour album on the front and back. Sizing goes from XXS to XXL.

Olivia Rodrigo Sour Graphic Baby Tee

This is another slim-fit baby tee from Olivia Rodrigo’s Sour era. The white tee features contrasting purple graphics subtly on the front and back.

Oliva Rodrigo’s Sour Graphic Baby Tee is slightly more subdued with the same construction. The graphic is the same light purple but slightly more worn in, making the shirt look lived in. These tees are comfortable and very fashionable and can be utilized as a basic when swapped out with your everyday white tee to create a more elevated look. As mentioned, these tees won’t be available for long, given their popularity upon first launch, so you’ll want to buy now before they’re gone.

You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love is set to drop June 12 via Geffen Records. This marks Rodrigo’s third studio LP, following up her last album, Guts , from 2023, which was a major success. The album opened at the top of the Billboard 200 and spawned the Billboard Hot 100  No. 1 single “Vampire.”
